snippet.title: Fangtopia Console Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Fangtopia is coming this spooky season to PC, PS5 and Nintendo Switch 2.

Sink your fangs into Fangtopia, a cozy and relaxing tile puzzle game. Assemble spooky landscapes from a stack of tiles and invite charming monsters to take up residence in your hauntingly beautiful town! 

Escape reality and enjoy a care-free, scare-free experience while building your perfect pumpkin-filled kingdom in Fangtopia.

Sign up to join our closed alpha playtest on Steam before July 14th: https://forms.office.com/e/Y3SyYWcxxP

Find out more: https://linktr.ee/fangtopia

#indiegames #cozygames #gametrailers
